Name: (CP) Penny's 2-Heart Event Edit - Don't touch wheelchairs.
Author: JocelynCade
Description:
A Minor Content Patcher Edit for Penny's 2-Heart Event.
Making it so Penny properly apologises to George for moving him and his wheelchair.
Moving someone in a wheelchair without asking is considered very rude and invasive in a lot of situations, so I felt George apologizing to Penny for getting (rightfully) upset with her felt a little... weird. And advocating for George makes you LOSE friendship points??
So I edited it.

Requirement:
Content Patcher

Installation:
1. Unzip the mod into Mods folder


Contains:

>Slight adjustment to George speaking to Penny before you enter.
>Edits first response to advocate for George. (Nets Positive Points)
>Changes the phrasing of your 2nd response to Penny. (Nets Negative Points)
>Edits George's Apology; instead of apologising, he kindly explains what she did wrong and lets her off the hook. He was rightfully upset.
>Penny the apologises properly to George.


[i]"Always ask the person using the wheelchair if he or she would like assistance BEFORE you help. It may not be needed or wanted. They might not always need help. Wheelchairs give the person in them a sense of mobility and allow them to take part activities that they otherwise wouldn’t be able to. This gives the person a sense of individualism. Sometimes they might not need help."[/i]
﻿[url=https://www.disabled-world.com/disability/awareness/wheelchair-etiquette.php]-From Disabled-World's 'Wheelchair Ettiquette'[/url]

Edits to Penny's 2-Heart Event to make her less ableist.
